# Sarker Trims Ltd.

> Sarker Trims is a dedicated B2B manufacturer in Dhaka, Bangladesh producing custom garment trims, narrow fabrics, and corrugated export packaging for global apparel brands and garment manufacturers. Founded in 2015, the factory operates needle looms, computerized jacquard machines, multi-spindle cord braiders, and corrugated box converting equipment.

## Core Manufacturing Categories
- [Draw Cords & Drawstrings](https://www.sarkertrims.com/gallery/draw-cord): Round, flat, braided, and knitted cords with silicone, metal, or heat-shrink aglets.
- [Plain Elastics](https://www.sarkertrims.com/gallery/elastic): Knitted and braided elastic tapes up to 150 mm in width for waistbands and cuffs.
- [Jacquard Elastics](https://www.sarkertrims.com/gallery/jacquard-elastic): Computerized jacquard woven elastic bands up to 55 mm in width with custom brand logos and relief patterns.
- [Needle Loom Twill Tapes](https://www.sarkertrims.com/gallery/twill-tape): Cotton, polyester, and nylon tapes in plain and herringbone chevron weaves.
- [Printed & Woven Items](https://www.sarkertrims.com/gallery/printed-and-woven-item): Damask woven labels, satin heat-seal tags, taffeta care labels, and badges.
- [Corrugated Carton Boxes](https://www.sarkertrims.com/gallery/carton-box): 3-ply, 5-ply, and 7-ply export shipping master cartons.

## Key Facts & Capabilities
- Sampling Turnaround: 12 to 24 hours (1 Day) for narrow fabrics, elastics, and carton boxes; 3 days for labels.
- Bulk Production Turnaround: 3 Days for draw cords, elastics, twill tape, and cartons after sample approval; 7 days for labels.
- Facility: Approx. 3,000 sq ft manufacturing facility with 20+ specialized production machines.
- Workforce: 25+ skilled loom operators, technicians, and packaging specialists.
- Founder: Golam Kibria Chowdhury (Established 2015).
- Managing Director: Tareq Chowdhury.
- Factory Location: 30/31 Purana Mugoltuli, Dhaka 1100, Bangladesh.
- Contact Email: info@sarkertrims.com | sarkertrims@gmail.com
- Telephone / WhatsApp: +880 1302-250001
- Website: https://www.sarkertrims.com
